assessmentLimitations.message: No APPID value format is defined (D12 is only an example). APPID existence and eligibility (C12: Operational Status Live/Planning/Legacy) require ServiceNow lookup, not implemented.
assessmentLimitations.source: Azure Tag Standard!C12, Azure Tag Standard!D12

assessmentLimitations.message: Values of CMDB-sourced tags (Application Name, Business Criticality, Data Classification, Primary Business Capability, Regulatory Controlled Information, Support Group, TIS Application Owner, TIS Portfolio Executive) were not compared with ServiceNow CMDB; no allowed-value lists are defined for them (examples only).
CreatedOnDate value format is not defined ('UTC date/time', automated); only presence is checked.
assessmentLimitations.source: Azure Tag Standard!C18, Azure Tag Standard!D18

assessmentLimitations.message: The standard defines no resource or resource-group naming conventions; naming is not assessed.
Example value '<blank>' (D22) is ambiguous (empty value vs literal text); presence is checked and any present value, including blank, satisfies presence.
A4 describes an inherit-from-resource-group policy; inheritance behaviour is not assessed.
The tagging standard defines no leading/trailing whitespace rule (ATG-REQ-007 is in the separate requirements workbook, not this standard); whitespace defects are not reported.

'Allocation' is listed under A6 'required tags' but B13 describes it as experimental; mandatory status and applicability await the standard owner. Excluded from scoring; not waived and not passed. Allocation percentages/shared-service applicability not inferred.
assessmentLimitations.source: Azure Tag Standard!A6, Azure Tag Standard!B13

rules.sourceSection: Azure Tag Standard!A43:A65 'Environment Type - as per SNOW CMDB' (22 values; identical set in C14). Exact, case-sensitive; present blank or whitespace-only values fail; absent tag is NOT_EVALUATED.
